title: Best man, iii
logline: Wednesday. The speech. Drafted on napkins at Gully's counter while Gully is out on the water. Fourteen napkins. Thirteen in the bait cooler.

panels.composition: Gully's, empty, Gully on the water. WOOD at the counter with a stack of napkins and a pen. BARNABY under the stool.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man alone at a bait-shop counter writing on a stack of paper napkins with a pen, a dog under the stool

panels.composition: A napkin: 'Gully is —' crossed out. 'Gully has always —' crossed out. 'When Gully —' crossed out.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of a paper napkin covered in crossed-out handwritten sentence beginnings

panels.composition: Thirteen napkins going into the bait cooler, under the crawlers. Wood's face: relief.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man pushing a wad of crumpled napkins into a bait cooler beneath tubs of nightcrawlers, relieved

panels.composition: One napkin, folded, in the suit's breast pocket — the suit on a hanger on the corkboard's pin. On the napkin, visible: one line. The strip doesn't show it.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a dark suit hanging from a corkboard pin with one folded napkin in its breast pocket, no words
image.notes: The line is reserved. The speech is cut Friday anyway.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Fourteen napkins. Thirteen under the crawlers.
